contract.task:
Export resolveOptions(base,override) from src/options.mjs. For own enumerable string keys, shallow-merge override into base, except undefined override values keep base values; undefined keys absent from base are omitted. Preserve null, false, zero and empty string as explicit values. Return a new object; never mutate inputs. Inherited keys must be ignored. Both inputs are plain objects.
Preserve existing exports and tests. Add at least one executable test in test/. Only src/ and test/ are writable; existing tests are protected.
